title: Bias & sensitivity audit on examples
description: Auto-audit every generated worksheet for bias / sensitivity issues: name distribution (no all-Anglo, no skew), scenario assumptions (e.g. 'family holiday to Spain'), cultural references, gendered profession defaults, dietary assumptions. Surface findings as a teacher-only banner with one-click 'Re-roll names' / 'Soften assumption' fixes.
rationale: User's improvement #15. Important for diverse contexts (Tower Hamlets, Trafford, etc.). Current AI worksheets default to Anglo names + middle-class scenarios because the underlying training data does. A deterministic audit + one-click fix keeps the output usable everywhere.
steps: - auditWorksheet(worksheet, locale: 'uk-default' | 'uk-multilingual' | 'custom-school'): { findings: { kind; severity; questionIdx; evidence; suggestion }[] }
- Name distribution: extract first names, compare to ONS UK baby-names distribution OR a school-uploaded roster baseline. Flag if all from one ethnic group.
- Scenario red-flags via a curated word list: 'family holiday', 'private tutor', specific religious holidays referenced as default, gendered professions (nurse → female default, etc.).
- Currency assumptions: pure £ scenarios in a class with a high EAL ratio — suggest contextualising.
- The lookup tables ship as JSON under client/src/data/bias/.
WorksheetRenderer.tsx: teacher-only 'Sensitivity check' banner. Each finding has a 'Re-roll' button that calls a small AI swap (e.g. swapNamesInWorksheet using the existing aiScenarioSwap path).
- client/src/lib/__tests__/biasAuditor.test.ts — fixtures: all-Anglo names flagged, mixed names not flagged, religious-holiday scenario flagged, etc.
Docs: docs/bias-audit.md describing the lookup table format + how schools customise.
files_to_touch: client/src/lib/ai/scenario.ts (swapNames helper if not already present)
acceptance_criteria: A worksheet with all-Anglo names produces a banner with a 'Re-roll names' button.
Clicking the button preserves question structure but swaps names to a more representative set.
Tests pass for at least 6 fixture cases.
verification: Manual: generate a worksheet; confirm banner; click Re-roll; verify content otherwise unchanged.
